newsitem.title: USA: Raytheon sells parts of appliance unit for $750mln.
newsitem.headline: Raytheon sells parts of appliance unit for $750mln.

text.p: Raytheon Co said Monday it has signed an agreement to sell the home appliance, heating and air conditioning, and commercial cooking segments of the its appliance group to Goodman Holding Co of Houston.

Cumulatively, Raytheon said it will realize a total of $750 million from transactions negotiated to date, including $550 million in cash from Goodman and $200 million from the sale of the appliance group receivables.
It said the sale is subject to U.S. government approval and it expects to complete the deal in the third quarter.
Raytheon said that to maximize shareholder value, it will retain its commercial laundry business as well as the electronic controls segment of the appliance group.
It said it is continuing its strategic assessment of these two businesses, which in 1996 accounted for approximately 20 percent of revenues and 50 percent of profits for the appliance group.
Goodman is privately held and owns several businesses, including Goodman Manufacturing Co, which makes heating and air conditioning products.
